name: Elis SA
summary: Elis SA provides flat linen, workwear, and hygiene and well-being solutions in France, Central Europe, Scandinavia, Eastern Europe, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Latin America, Southern Europe, and internationally. It offers accommodation, catering, and healthcare and social linens; workwear and personal protective equipment; beverage solutions, such as bottled water cooler, coffee bean machine, networked water cooler, and pod coffee machine; floor protection mats and mops; industrial wipers; and pest and rodent control, insect control, or disinfection services.
